2185. Employee Salary Management Using Structures and DMA

90

Hard

A company wants to maintain employee records dynamically.

Write a C program using structures and Dynamic Memory Allocation to store employee details and identify the employee receiving the highest salary.

Define a structure  Employee  containing:

Employee ID

Employee Name

Salary

Your program should:

Read the number of employees N.

Dynamically allocate memory for N employee structures using  malloc() .

Read the ID, name and salary of each employee.

Pass the structure array to a function named  findHighestSalary() .

Identify the employee with the highest salary.

Print the complete details of that employee.

Release the allocated memory using  free() .
input_spec:
First line contains N.

Each subsequent line contains employee ID, employee name and salary.
output_spec:
Employee ID: 102
Employee Name: Priya
Salary: 45000.00
